english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), failed without reasonable excuse to comply with or contravened the requirement or prohibition imposed by a litter abatement notice issued by **(..SPECIFY THE AUTHORITY..) and served on you on **(..SPECIFY DATE..), in that **(..SPECIFY THE FAILURE..)

english.notes:
From 20th October 2014, the power to serve a litter abatement notice under section 92(1) of the Environmental Protection Act 1990 is no longer in force. The repeal does not, however, apply in relation to a notice served under that section before that date or anything done in connection with such a notice. As such, this offence can still be committed in relation to a notice served before 20th October 2014.

In any proceedings for an offence under section 92(6) of the Environmental Protection Act 1990, it shall be a defence for the person charged to prove that he has complied, as respects the land in question, with his duty under section 89(1).

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Note;
A further fine of an amount equal to one-twentieth of that level for each day on which the offence continues after the conviction.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
